title: An Early Rug Pull
summary: They tried this morning, they really did. There were a few attempts at rallies in the pre-market, but those eventually succumbed to a lack of follow-through. There was some mild enthusiasm after a better-than-expected headline PPI reading, but that faded when traders realized that any improvement was offset by upward revisions to last month’s figures. More importantly, a nascent bounce in hard-hit Nvidia (NVDA) reversed course, and that led to a broader bout of selling in tech stocks. As of now, indexes are off their lows, but meandering at lower levels.
